# OddXandre — UX/UI & Visual Designer Portfolio

## About
OddXandre (Pedro Carreras) is a UX/UI & Visual Designer based in Málaga, Spain. Specializes in product design, strategic branding, web and mobile interfaces, design systems, and user experience.

## Services
- UX/UI Design
- Visual Design
- Strategic Branding
- Digital Product Design
- Web & Mobile Interface Design
- Design Systems
- UX Consulting

## Skills & Tools
Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro), Framer, Notion, AI-assisted design, GSAP, Web technologies

## Work Experience
- Product & UX/UI Designer at BeByte S.L. (Apr 2025 — Sep 2025)
- UX/UI, Visual & Multimedia Designer at Credo.si (Jan 2024 — Dec 2024)
- UX/UI & Visual Designer at Impar.ux (Jun 2022 — Sep 2024)

## Notable Projects
- **Inboxe Fitboxing**: UX/UI and gamification for a fitness platform in Brazil (BeByte, 2026)
- **Tito David**: Wine brand identity and packaging design (Independent, 2026)
- **Cerveza Paleña**: Visual identity inspired by Málaga's El Palo neighborhood (Independent, 2025)
- **Beyond Frames**: Apple Vision Pro spatial design concept (EASD San Telmo, 2024)
- **Copao**: Mental health awareness campaign design (Credo, 2024)
- **Aguas de Benahavís**: 15-year branding campaign (Credo, 2024)
- **Infoca**: Environmental awareness campaign (Credo, 2024)
- **Nook**: Contextual productivity app design (EASD San Telmo, 2023)

## Design Philosophy
"Design with intention, not decoration. Visual and functional must work together. Clear systems, self-explanatory experiences, and a visual presence that doesn't need to shout."
